# dnax.ui

> dnax.ui is a Vue 3 design system with a Quasar-style public API — `<q-btn flat dense no-caps>`, boolean modifier props, `v-model` conventions, kebab-case tags — built on shadcn-vue techniques (cva, `cn()`, tailwind-merge, CSS token theming, Iconify icons). This file indexes the documentation site so an LLM can navigate every component, plugin and guide. All pages are written in English.

## About the docs

Each component page follows the same structure: a short lead describing the component, a series of interactive demo sections (each with a Preview / Code tab, and a Script setup block when state is involved), then an **API** section rendered by `docs-api`, with tabs for **Props** (name, type, values, default, required), **Slots**, **Events** (with payloads) and **Methods**. Component props are written in kebab-case in templates and camelCase in TypeScript. Most components accept the shared modifiers `dense`, `outlined`, `bordered`, `flat`, `disable`, `readonly`, `dark`, `color`/`text-color`, `size` and a `label`.

The design system lives in `@dnax/ui` (npm package `@dnax/ui`, source in `packages/ui/`): every `Q*` component is exported from the package root and auto-registered by the Nuxt module as a kebab-case tag (e.g. `QBtn` → `<q-btn>`). Global styles and tokens are in `styles/main.css`. Plugins are used through the `$q` object (`$q.dialog`, `$q.notify`, `$q.loading`, `$q.imagePreview`, `$q.bottomSheet`, `$q.localStorage` / `$q.sessionStorage`).

## Plugins API

The imperative plugins are called through the `$q` object (available after installing the corresponding provider, typically mounted by `q-config-provider`). Each page documents the plugin methods, options and the declarative component equivalent when one exists.

## Key implementation notes for LLMs

- **Dual identity**: public API is Quasar-flavored (`Q*` component names, kebab-case tags, boolean modifier props, `v-model`), implementation is shadcn-vue-style (cva variants, `cn()` from `lib/utils.ts`, CSS token variables, Iconify icons from `lib/icons.ts`).
- **Form components** use `:model-value` + `@update:model-value`; visibility components (dialog, menu, sidebar, bottom-sheet) use a boolean `v-model` plus `@show`/`@hide` where relevant.
- **Colors**: most components accept `color` / `text-color` with either design tokens (`primary`, `secondary`, `positive`, `negative`, `warning`, `info`) or any CSS color.
- **Safe-area**: fullscreen components (headers, footers, bottom sheets, dialogs, FABs, sheets) apply iOS safe-area insets via `env(safe-area-inset-*)` — requires `viewport-fit=cover`.
- **Dark mode**: driven by a `.dark` class on a parent (tokens in `styles/main.css`); components inherit `--foreground`, `--card`, `--muted`, `--border` etc.
- **Icons**: Iconify names like `lucide:menu`; some components accept an `icon` prop.
- **Back closes overlays**: the Nuxt module auto-installs an `overlayBack` plugin (`installOverlayBackHandler`) — on browser/Capacitor back navigation, the topmost open overlay (dialog, bottom sheet, action sheet, image preview, sidebar, select/date-picker/country-picker in sheet/modal/dialog mode) closes instead of navigating. Components register themselves via `useOverlayBack(open, close, label)` (`lib/overlayBack.ts`); disable with `dnaxUi: { overlayBack: false }`.
- **Web storage** (`lib/storage.ts`): `$q.localStorage` / `$q.sessionStorage` keep the original value type (Date, RegExp, number, boolean, string, plain objects) via a prefixed encoding (`__q_*`) that is byte-compatible with Quasar's Web Storage plugin; SSR/blocked storage yields a no-op store. Direct imports `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` from `@dnax/ui`.
- **v-close directive** (`lib/closeOverlay.ts`): registered globally by the Nuxt module (client mode) as `v-close` — on click closes the closest overlay that marked itself via `markOverlayClose` (`q-dialog`, `q-bottom-sheet` and their `$q` hosts); `v-close="false"` disables it. Equals Quasar `v-close-popup`.
- **v-touch-pan directive** (`lib/touchPan.ts`): registered by the Nuxt module as `v-touch-pan` — Pointer Events based pan detection (touch by default, add `.mouse` for pointer), direction filters `.horizontal`/`.vertical`/`.up`/`.down`/`.left`/`.right`, `.prevent` blocks native scroll, `.stop`/`.capture`/`.passive`; handler receives Quasar-style `PanDetails` (evt, position, direction, delta, distance, duration, speed, isFirst/isFinal, isVertical/isHorizontal). Page `/docs/directives/touch-pan`.
- **v-touch-hold directive** (`lib/touchHold.ts`): registered as `v-touch-hold` — long-press detection (600ms default, configurable via value: number | `'time:sensT:sensM'` | `{ time, sensitivity, mouseSensitivity }`), touch 5px / mouse 7px default sensitivity; `.mouse` includes pointer; the gesture is consumed on trigger (no click afterwards). Page `/docs/directives/touch-hold`.
- **v-touch-swipe / v-touch-repeat** (`lib/touchSwipe.ts`, `lib/touchRepeat.ts`): registered as `touch-swipe` / `touch-repeat`. Swipe: fast flick released (≥ 50px within ≤ 300ms), axis filters `.horizontal/.vertical/.up/.down/.left/.right`, `.mouse`, thresholds `{ distance, duration }`, details (evt, direction, distance, duration, speed). Repeat: repeats the handler while pressed — first call after `delay` (600ms), then every `interval` (150ms); value number | `'delay:interval'` | `{ delay, interval }`, `.mouse`. Pages `/docs/directives/touch-swipe` & `/docs/directives/touch-repeat`.
- **v-intersection directive** (`lib/intersection.ts`): registered as `v-intersection` — IntersectionObserver wrapper; value = handler | `{ handler, cfg }` (observer options) | `false` (off); `.once` stops observing after first entry; observers are pooled per identical cfg (cheap long lists). Page `/docs/directives/intersection`.
- **Rich text editor** (`QTiptap`, page `/docs/components/tiptap`): wraps Tiptap v3 (`@tiptap/vue-3` + `@tiptap/starter-kit`, dependencies of `@dnax/ui`); `v-model` reads/writes HTML; the ProseMirror editor is created client-side in `onMounted` (SSR-safe) and destroyed on unmount. Built-in **toolbar** (`toolbar` prop) — undo/redo, headings, alignment, marks, text color (palette popover with “No color”), links & images (URL via `q-dialog`), bullet/ordered/**task lists** (`q-checkbox` NodeView), blockquote, code block — plus a **bubble menu** (`@tiptap/vue-3/menus`) on text selection and a **drag handle** (`@tiptap/extension-drag-handle-vue-3`, nested enabled) on block hover; `@mentions` via the `mentions` prop (`{ label, value }[]`, `@tiptap/extension-mention`), and a **table of contents** (`@tiptap/extension-table-of-contents`) re-emitted on every change through the `@update:toc` event (anchors: id, textContent, level, originalLevel, itemIndex, pos, isActive, isScrolledOver). Note `EditorContent` does not forward class/style attributes → the editor is wrapped in `.q-tiptap__editor`; external HTML is only pushed via `setContent(…, { emitUpdate: false })` when it really differs; teleported popups define their own `--q-tiptap-*` tokens.
